title: Add library-relative network claim fields
summary: Implement C2 from the network worker hardening plan by adding additive library_id and relative_path claim fields and resolving them on workers before falling back to prefix maps.
reason: Absolute coordinator-local source paths require fragile prefix matching; library-relative claims let a worker resolve by configured library ID without changing older workers.
behavior_before: ClaimResponse only carried source_path, so workers had to reverse-map the coordinator absolute path with manual or auto prefix rules.
behavior_after: ClaimResponse will also carry library_id and relative_path when known, and new workers will resolve worker library root plus relative path before falling back to C1 auto/manual maps and raw source_path.
